title: Schedule (step 1) or one-file demand: one simulated day
description: Who goes where, when and by which mode, for one day. Written by the LLM (llm_stub.py stands in until then) and read by convert_demand.py, which also checks what a schema cannot: every agent_id and location_id exists in agents.json, the day starts at the agent's own home, a mode is given exactly on entries at a different place from the one before, end times increase, and every trip can be made. See README.md.

made_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (model, prompt version).

schedule.description: The day in order. The first entry is the agent's home (home_id in agents.json).

location_id.description: The agent's home_id, or a location_id from agents.json.

activity.description: What they do there, e.g. home, work, school, market. Optional.

start.description: Planned start, for reading only: the simulation does not use it.

end.description: When they leave. Needed on every entry but the last.

mode.description: How they get to this entry from the one before. Only in the one-file form, on every entry at a different place from the one before. A schedule for the modes file (step 1) has no mode.

reasoning.description: Why, in a sentence. Optional, kept for reading.
